capabilities: Detect the exact word TODO in edit and preview modes
Highlight occurrences using a CodeMirror decoration in edit mode
Wrap occurrences in a span in preview mode
Set the highlight colour via a hex code in settings
disambiguation: It does not create, track or manage tasks; it only colour-highlights the literal word TODO.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to visually mark TODO keywords in notes while reading or editing.
summary: Plugin that highlights every occurrence of the word TODO in notes with a user-configured colour, in both edit and preview modes.
